Title: Azure Cosmos DB Java V3 SDK now available

Body.Content:
Now generally available, the Azure Cosmos DB Java V3 SDK features include a new, more intuitive, idiomatic programming model with developer-friendly APIs, Reactor-based async programming model, and added support for Azure Cosmos DB direct TCP transport protocols to increase performance and availability.  Use the Azure Cosmos DB Change Feed processor APIs, now directly integrated into the SDK, and begin using partition keys to scale previously non-partitioned containers. The SDK also has a new package name, azure-cosmos.

Get started today with our quickstart.

Get started today with our tutorial

Learn about the new package name "azure-cosmos"

Learn more at GitHub
